welcome.title: 1v1 Local Match
welcome.content: Play against a friend on the same keyboard! First player to reach the target score wins.

controls.title: Controls
controls.content:
Use W and S keys OR ↑ and ↓ arrow keys to move your paddle up and down.

Share the keyboard with your opponent!

gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.content:
• Hit the ball with your paddle to keep it in play
• Score by making the ball pass your opponent's paddle
• First player to reach the target score wins
• The ball speeds up as the game progresses

welcome.title: Tournament Mode
welcome.content: Compete in a tournament bracket! Players take turns, winners advance to the next round.

controls.title: Controls
controls.content:
Player 1: Use W and S keys to move your paddle up and down.

Player 2: Use ↑ and ↓ arrow keys to move your paddle up and down.

Players take turns playing matches.

gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.content:
• Each match follows standard Pong rules
• Winners advance to the next round
• The tournament bracket shows who plays next
• Last player standing wins the tournament!

welcome.title: Online Multiplayer
welcome.content: Play against players from around the world in real-time matches!

controls.title: Controls
controls.content: Use W and S keys to move your paddle up and down. Your opponent controls their own paddle remotely.

gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.content:
• Real-time gameplay via WebSocket connection
• Score by making the ball pass your opponent's paddle
• First player to reach the target score wins
• Matches are recorded in your match history

welcome.title: Online Tournament
welcome.content: Compete in an online tournament bracket! Multiple players join, winners advance to the next round until one champion remains.

controls.title: Controls
controls.content: Use W and S keys to move your paddle up and down. Each player controls their own paddle remotely during their match.

gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.content:
• Join a tournament lobby or create your own
• Players are matched in tournament brackets
• Winners advance to the next round automatically
• The tournament bracket shows who plays next
• Last player standing wins the tournament!
• All matches are recorded in your match history
